player_prompt.intro:
Yin ee raan {player_id} ee Connect Four.
Kïït ee raan: {symbol}.
Taabla ee tuɛm aye {num_rows} kuɛl ku {num_cols} kuɛɛl.
Raan kɛɛl aye tïŋ kuɛɛl kɛɛl (0 tɛ {end_col}).
Raan ee tuɛm aye dɔɔɔr kɛɛl kɛɛl aye diɔɔɔŋ kuɛɛl aye dɛɛl, ku kuɛɛl aye dɛɛl, ku kuɛɛl aye dɛɛl tɛ dɛɛl.
Yen ee tuɛm, kïït ee kuɛɛl nɔm tïŋ kuɛɛl tɛ kɛɛl kuɛɛl.
Tɛɛŋɛn: '[col 4]' ku '[col 1]'.

board.board_notvisible_state: Kä ji̱ ŋarä /ca kɛ nɛn ɛ nɛy tin la ŋa̱a̱ri.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Riäŋ {player_id}, Cɛɛk nhɛ̈k ke ye guɔp. Guɔp ee: '[col x]'.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Riäŋ {player_id}, Cɛɛk nhɛ̈k. Kuɔl {col} ee kɛ̈ kɔ̈k.
invalid_move.already_full: Riäŋ {player_id}, Cɛɛk nhɛ̈k. Kuɔl {col} ee full.

action.dropped_disk: Riäŋ {player_id} thok kuɔl de ({player_symbol}) thɛ̈ɛ̈r kuɔl {col}.

outcome.win: Ji̱ ŋarä {player_id} bi̱ kɛ ku tieec ɛ la nɛy da̱ŋ ŋuan!
outcome.draw: Ɛn ŋar cɛ thuɔ̱k kɛ mi ci nɛy diaal ɛ wɔ̱.
